sentences.text:
The instant misc. petition has been filed by the petitioners for quashing of Fir
No.42/2023, Police Station Sojat Raod, District Pali for offences under Sections 498A, 406, 323, 377
& 376 of Ipc.

Learned Public Prosecutor has submitted a report dated 16.05.2023 received from SHO, Police Station Sojat Road, District Pali wherein it has been mentioned that offences under Sections 498A,
406 IPC have been proved against the petitioner No.1 Rajendra Kumar and no offence has been proved against the petitioner No.2 Narayanlal.
The said report is hereby taken on record.
] In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the present misc. petition has become infructuous and dismissed accordingly.
